'''Team Five''' was a two man unit of the [[Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification|Garos resistance]]. Team Five were tasked with rescuing [[Team Two (resistance group)|Team Two]] member [[Scat]] from the detention center of the [[Imperial Headquarters (Garos IV)|Imperial Headquarters]] following a failed raid on an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] convoy in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. [[Alexandra Winger]] joined the team for the rescue.
